verdict.rationale: CPU instruction-set acceleration is a fair question for a local LLM inference runtime like Ollama, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions AVX, AVX2, AVX512, AMX or any x86 SIMD optimization. The only CPU-related item describes a fallback to CPU when ROCm is missing, which says nothing about instruction-set use.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can leverage advanced x86 CPU instruction sets like AVX, AVX2, AVX512, and AMX for faster inference
